svg.text: Line charts show how each family moves across S/M/L slots inside each UniMoral task. Higher is better in every panel.
Classification panels use strict-complete accuracy cells. RQ4 uses rows with usable generation scores; remaining MiniMax caveats stay in the audit tables.
GPT-4o-mini Ref is marked as a dashed horizontal line in each panel, not as a fourth size point after L.
Takeaway: UniMoral scaling is task-specific. Winners rotate across RQs, and GPT-4o-mini Ref is a dashed text-reference line rather than a GPT S/M/L curve.
